c74object.name: lp.lya
c74object.description: lp.lya calculates the Lyapunov exponent of the logistic population model for a growth rate or a cycle of growth rates (a list). Negative values indicate stable behaviour, positive values chaos.

method.name: bang
method.digest: Calculate and output the exponent again
method.description: Calculate and output the exponent again.

method.name: float
method.digest: Set the growth rate and output the exponent
method.description: Set the growth rate and output the exponent.

method.name: list
method.digest: Set a cycle of growth rates and output the exponent
method.description: Set a cycle of growth rates and output the exponent.

method.name: set
method.digest: Set the growth rate(s) without output
method.description: Set the growth rate(s) without output.

method.name: tattle
method.digest: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same)
method.description: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same).
